I will grow this maize the way I know, but I will put fertilizer on this plot because maize eats a lot and I have seen people here harvest better when they use it. I will use hybrid seed if I can get it, and I will also throw in manure from home because this land is mine and I do not want it to get weak. I will not buy pesticide or herbicide for this plot, and I will wait for the rains, not irrigation. Because I am old now, my family will work many days here, and I will also pay for some help at the busy time.
